side_effects.detail: No Redis server is reachable, so the 3 Redis-backed tests (including test_get_or_compute_caches_falsy_value) were skipped. The get_or_compute fix is covered by a new fake-client test that does run.
Removed the __pycache__ directories (git-ignored) that the test runs generated.

summary: get_or_compute now checks whether the raw Redis value is None to decide hit vs. miss, so falsy values (0, '', [], {}, False, null) are cached. LRUCache.get now marks the key as most recently used. serializers.dumps writes datetime/date/time values as ISO 8601 strings. Added a parametrized get_or_compute test that uses an in-memory fake client so the fix is tested without Redis. The existing tests for the LRU and datetime bugs now pass.
